title: 第7章 炼化血肉能量引气开海第8章 就算是饿死也不吃
slug: 厨神把师姐们喂成女帝
content_zh:
牛下水就是牛的内脏，重中之重的就是那牛肚！
不过他不知道这修炼界的人喜不喜欢这玩意，别给扔了。
程小云脆声道，“等着，我回山看看，要是还在的话就给你拿来，那东西也就我爹爱吃。”
“令尊大人是…”
“御兽峰程大发。”
程小云转身离开了。
林东方双手揪着围裙打量着牛肉，心里想了想。
“看来圣主和一些峰主首座说过我了，不然御兽峰也不会送来这灵兽牛肉。”
“这牛肉真是绝了，在地球上哪有品质这么好的牛肉。”
这一头牛在他脑海里已经翻出一百个花样了。
用优质的食材来烹饪美食，简直就是一种享受。
“先搞个最经典的卤牛肉吧，正好再调一锅卤牛肉的老汤。”
老汤这东西趁早不趁晚，越久越香。
“然后今晚整个炒牛柳，再烧一锅西红柿牛腩汤。”
“要是牛肚还在的话就下火锅。”
“那样的话就要熬牛油，今天有的忙了。”
卤鸡和卤牛肉可不能用同一锅汤，甚至汤锅不能放在一个屋子里，时间久了蒸汽多了容易串味。
他这小院其实挺大的，只是房屋不多，除去他的卧室，客厅，厨房，就剩下两间客房。
遇到难题就召唤大师姐！
萧曦月自然知道这牛肉是哪来的。

得知林东方这厨房不够大之后，她也没耽误。
素手一挥，琴匣内飞出一把白玉长剑飞向远处的竹林。
长剑横劈竖斩，不多时就砍伐了足够多的竹子。
碗口粗的竹子被一条红菱捆着，一排排的飞进林东方的小院。
这手段让林东方一脸羡慕。
妙音峰上的竹子十分结实，他用锯子整半天都难以搞出一个豁口。
“嘭嘭嘭…”
萧曦月再一挥手，这一排排竹子纷纷扎进泥土里。
小手指粗的藤蔓像是灵蛇一样在竹子之间蜿蜒爬行，把墙和屋顶固定好。
五六米方圆的小竹屋顷刻间被建成。
窗户和门有板有眼。
萧曦月还贴心的布置下风阵，卤鸡的小屋在东边，所以风向东方吹。
卤牛肉的小屋在西边，所以风向西边吹。
两种香味并不会在院内冲突，反而飘向远方…
然后是火属性阵法，放汤锅用。
汤锅都刻有空间法阵，里面远比外面看起来宽广。
剩下的竹子在院子里做了一个大桌子，足以放下那一整头牛，还布置下冰阵，只要激活就可以把牛肉冰封。
content_en:
The cow's guts are the cow's internal organs, and the most important thing is the tripe!
But he doesn't know if people in the cultivation world like this thing, so don't throw it away.
Cheng Xiaoyun said crisply, "Wait, I'll go back to the mountain and have a look. If it's still there, I'll bring it to you. That's what my dad likes to eat."
"Your Majesty is..."
"Cheng Dafa from the Beast Control Peak."
Cheng Xiaoyun turned and left.
Lin Dongfang held his apron with both hands and looked at the beef, thinking for a while.
"It seems that the Holy Master and some of the peak masters have told me, otherwise the Beast Control Peak would not have sent this spiritual beast beef."
"This beef is really amazing. There is no such good quality beef anywhere on earth."
This cow has already turned out a hundred tricks in his mind.
Cooking delicious food with high-quality ingredients is simply a pleasure.
"Let's make the most classic braised beef first, and then we'll make a pot of braised beef soup."
Laotang is something that should be cooked sooner rather than later. The longer it lasts, the more fragrant it will be.
"Then stir-fry the whole beef tenderloin tonight and make a pot of tomato and beef brisket soup."
"If the tripe is still there, I'll serve hot pot."
"In that case, we have to boil butter. I'm very busy today."
Braised chicken and braised beef cannot be used in the same pot of soup, and the soup pots cannot even be placed in the same room. Over time, too much steam will easily cause odor transfer.
His small courtyard is actually quite big, but there are not many houses. Apart from his bedroom, living room, and kitchen, there are only two guest rooms left.
When you encounter a problem, call the senior sister!
Xiao Xiyue naturally knew where the beef came from.
After learning that Lin Dongfang's kitchen was not big enough, she didn't waste any time.
With a wave of his hand, a long white jade sword flew out of the piano box and flew towards the bamboo forest in the distance.
The long sword slashed horizontally and vertically, and in a short time enough bamboo was cut down.
Bamboos as thick as a bowl were tied with a red caltrop and flew into Lin Dongfang's courtyard in rows.
This method made Lin Dongfang envious.
The bamboo on Miaoyin Peak was so strong that he couldn't make a gap with a saw for a long time.
"Bang bang bang..."
Xiao Xiyue waved her hand again, and the rows of bamboos plunged into the soil.
Little finger-thick vines snaked between the bamboos like snakes, fixing the walls and roof in place.
A small bamboo house with a radius of five to six meters was built in an instant.
The windows and doors are well designed.
Xiao Xiyue also thoughtfully arranged the downwind array. The braised chicken hut is on the east side, so the wind blows to the east.
The braised beef hut is on the west side, so the wind blows westward.
The two scents do not conflict in the courtyard, but float into the distance...
Then there is the fire attribute formation, which is used to place the soup pot.
The soup pots are all engraved with space formations, and the inside is much wider than it looks from the outside.
The remaining bamboo was used to make a large table in the yard, big enough to place the whole cow, and an ice array was also arranged, which could freeze the beef as long as it was activated.
